entries.title: Night-shift dispatcher to operations lead
entries.detail: Joined Marlowe Cold Chain in 2017 as the only night dispatcher for 14 refrigerated trucks. Became operations lead in 2022 with 61 trucks and three depots to answer for.
entries.words: For five years my desk was a phone, a whiteboard and a kettle.

entries.title: Spoilage claims after the door-open rule
entries.detail: Spoilage claims fell from 37 in the first half of 2024 to 11 in the second half after we capped dock door-open time at 6 minutes per load.

figure.measures: customer spoilage claims per half-year across three depots
figure.basis: claims ledger kept by finance, same customers both halves

entries.words: Nobody had ever timed the door. We had timed everything else.

entries.title: The paper route board
entries.detail: Built a laminated route board for the Tilbrook depot in March 2023 after the planning software went down for 9 days. Drivers kept using it after the software came back.
entries.words: The outage ended. The board stayed.

entries.title: Stopped believing in route optimisation first
entries.detail: Spent 2021 pushing for a route optimiser. A week riding along in truck 22 in January 2022 showed the lost time was at the dock, not on the road.
entries.before: The route is where the minutes are lost.
entries.after: The dock is where the minutes are lost; the route only shows it.
entries.words: I had been optimising the part I could see on a map.

entries.title: The Easter weekend reefer failure
entries.detail: Approved a deferred compressor service on two trailers in March 2023. Both failed over Easter and we wrote off 4 pallets of dairy for Halvorsen Foods.
entries.price: About 19,000 in product, one driver's holiday, and a customer review meeting I did not enjoy.
entries.words: I saved a service slot and bought a write-off.

entries.title: Dispatch should sit next to the dock, not in head office
entries.detail: Moved two dispatchers from the head office floor to a cabin beside the Tilbrook dock in 2024. Radio calls about load order dropped by roughly half within 3 weeks.
entries.against: Most ops directors I know, who want planners near finance and sales.
entries.words: A planner who cannot hear the forklifts is guessing.

entries.title: The driver who labelled the fridge
entries.detail: A driver called Bram taped a note inside trailer 9 in 2019 that said 'this one lies by two degrees'. He was right, and the sensor had been wrong for 7 months.
entries.words: This one lies by two degrees.

entries.title: Pick accuracy improvement
entries.detail: We improved pick accuracy significantly after changing the bay layout.

entries.title: First hire I got wrong
entries.detail: Hired a depot supervisor recently who left quickly.

entries.title: Thursday cab ride-along
entries.detail: Since September 2022 every office hire spends one Thursday a quarter in a cab. 23 people have done it, including the finance director.
entries.words: You plan differently once you have waited at a locked gate.

A planner who cannot hear the forklifts is guessing.
